label: Anybus X-gateway Modbus TCP Server / PROFINET-IRT Device
description: DIN-rail protocol gateway that maps cyclic I/O between a Modbus TCP server interface and a PROFINET-IRT device interface (512 bytes in and out each way), so a Modbus TCP master and a PROFINET controller can exchange process data without any PLC card slot. Two RJ45 ports per network side, 24 VDC input.
notes: Technical specifications tab: 'Connectors / Input / Output: 2xRJ45, 2x RJ45, USB-B Config port'; 'Modbus-TCP Bandwidth: 10/100 Mbit/s' with 'Daisy chaining' in the supported-functionality list, and 'PROFINET Bandwidth: 100MBit full duplex down to 1ms cycle time' (IRT requires the two-port switch). So the four RJ45s are two independent switched pairs - a Modbus TCP pair and a PROFINET pair - and traffic never crosses between them at layer 2. They are modelled as four ports with no l2-forward precisely because claiming a bridge would wrongly suggest the two networks are joined; the payload crossing between them is application-level mapping, not routing. Configuration is by web page / Anybus Configuration Manager over Ethernet.
